lesson-intro.text: Every wizard keeps a shelf of potions, and this one is ready to pour. It's a round flask, a wavy line of purple and three gold rings. Watch it brew, then mix up a bottle of your own.

body-left.text: The flask is a big round belly. From the neck, curve down the left side to the flat bottom.

body-right.text: Now the right side, rounding down from the neck until it meets the bottom.

ring-low.text: The neck starts with a gold ring. Close the top with a short line, then lay a band with round ends on it.

neck-low.text: A short piece of neck stands on the ring, then a second ring just like the first.

neck-top.text: One more piece of neck, the third ring, and the cork pushed in on top.

potion.text: Now the potion. A wavy line crosses the flask, a little above the middle.

bubbles.text: Five bubbles float in the potion. The big one sits low, the four smaller ones around it.

blue.text: The glass above it and both pieces of neck are blue.

gold.text: Gold for the three rings and brown for the cork.

lesson-outro.text: One potion, corked and ready. What do you think it does?
